title: Seaside "Sea ya real soon" 73 Odessa Street
h1: Seaside "Sea ya real soon" 73 Odessa Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Short walk to the beach- Access to the town amenities, 3 swimming pools, 6 tennis courts (court fees apply), and a fitness center- Beautiful tower views of the Gulf (actually featured in the film, The Truman Show)- Sprawling sundeck- 4 adult bikes provided- TVs in all bedrooms-cable in primary and living room, streaming in the others- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Say "See ya real soon" to your dream 30A vacation when you book your stay in this wonderful Seaside home! Tucked away in a quiet neighborhood and located just a quick walk from the beach is 73 Odessa Street, a beautiful 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home with lovely accommodations for 10 guests.The spacious screened porch and white Adirondack furnishings set the scene for a serene coastal retreat. Plush furnishings and a large flat-screen TV welcome guests to relax in the comfortable living area. The kitchen is perfectly equipped with everything you need to enjoy preparing fresh meals. Nearby, a dining table, breakfast bar, and banquette provide ample room for guest dining.The second floor presents a beautiful primary bedroom featuring a king bed, abundant natural light from 2 sets of French doors leading to the porches, and a private bathroom with a glass-front shower. This level also offers 2 additional guest rooms, 1 with a queen bed and 1 with a full bed, and a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The third floor offers 3 twin beds, a single sleeper sofa, and access to an expansive and beautifully furnished sun deck. From the fourth-floor watchtower, guests can take in the stunning gulf views. This home's incredible location is just a quick and beautiful walk to the sugar-white sand and sparkling emerald waters.Experience the best coastal dining, shopping, and entertainment along 30A by taking a breezy ride on the home's four adult beach cruiser bikes. Guests in this home will also enjoy access to three immaculate community pools (including one conveniently located just across the street), tennis courts, and a fitness center. Ready to book your perfect coastal getaway? Plan your stay at 73 Odessa Street today! If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Unfortunately, the HOA in this community prohibits Low-Speed Vehicle rentals or for guests to bring their own.
